{"reason": "All shown failures are demand-forecast-error misrouted to unknown (23 unknowns; recovery-rate 0.607). Two patterns: forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 falls under the 0.1 threshold, and market-mismatch=#t rows have no branch. Lower the bias threshold to 0.06 and add a market-signal-mismatch branch mapping to 'demand-forecast-error.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
